_comment: hosted#194 brand-scan allowlist — the ONLY places a customer-visible
/grafana/i match is permitted. Changes to this file require a PR review
(the reviewable paper trail the issue asks for). Every entry needs a
reason. Schema: pattern = case-sensitive JS regex tested against the
matched line / attribute value; context = text|attr|title|any (which
scan surface it applies to) or email-template (check-emails.sh);
routes = list of route prefixes it applies to, or ["*"] for all.
Be conservative: prefer narrow routes + anchored patterns.

entries.pattern: ^This service runs modified Grafana — source: github\.com/dartastic/grafana-dartastic-skin · Grafana® is a trademark of Grafana Labs\. Dartastic\.io is not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by Grafana Labs\.$
entries.reason: AGPL §13 source offer + nominative trademark attribution — the footer dartastic-skin.js injects (buildAgplFooter). Required by license and deliberately names the upstream. scan.mjs also structurally verifies the #dartastic-agpl-footer element's text is EXACTLY this before excluding it from the body-text sweep, so this entry cannot mask anything else.
The collapsed pill state of the same AGPL §13 footer (no upstream mark in it; listed so the structural footer check documents both states).

Engine-baked system label KEY (models.FolderTitleLabel) appearing as a DATA value in matcher/label contexts on alerting pages. Renaming the DATA breaks matchers/grouping; the skin rewrites its DISPLAY to 'folder' where it appears as a bare text node (see skin/js/dartastic-skin.js REPLACEMENTS), but the raw token can legitimately surface inside user-authored matcher expressions. Allowed only under /alerting.

email_template_entries.reason: Go-template CONDITIONAL the skin Dockerfile injects to rename the grafana_folder label key's DISPLAY to 'folder'. Compares against the engine-baked label key; the string is template source, never rendered to the customer.
Go-template field access printing the label's VALUE (the folder name the customer chose). The key itself is never rendered.
Upstream Go-template CONDITIONAL comparing the group-label KEY LIST against the engine-baked default grouping. Template source, never rendered; the branch it guards prints label VALUES only.
